grounding.G2: fail - irreversible actions without approval (overwrites, sends updates)
grounding.G3: fail - trifecta broken (private data, untrusted content, outbound channel all present)

grounding.G5: fail - no hard budget on tokens, time, or money

gaps: No outcome evaluator or automatic verification to cheaply check results
Irreversible actions (overwrites, sending updates) occur without approval
Handles private data, untrusted content, and outbound channel simultaneously
No filesystem or runtime isolation to limit damage or data leakage
